user.title: Connect Cosori air fryer
user.description: Sign in with the same account you use in the VeSync app. Your password is not stored, only its MD5 value (which VeSync needs to log in).

data_description.region: EU for Germany and Europe, US for North America.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: VeSync rejected the login for {email}. Please enter the password again.

error.keine_verbindung: Cannot reach the VeSync server. Try again later.
error.keine_fritteuse: No air fryer in this account. Add it in the VeSync app first.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

data.zeiteinheit: Time values of the air fryer

data_description.intervall: While cooking, it is always polled every 15 seconds.
data_description.zeiteinheit: Only change if the remaining time is shown 60 times too large or too small.
data_description.sidebar: Adds a "Fritteuse" entry to the sidebar (full-page view with the ticker and the zone card). Off by default.

geraet_unbekannt.message: This device does not belong to Airfryer Control.

start_nicht_unterstuetzt.message: Starting is not (yet) supported on this older model.

abgelehnt.message: The air fryer rejected the command: {fehler}

senden_abgelehnt.message: Die Fritteuse hat „Senden“ abgelehnt. Probierte Schreibweisen und Codes: {codes}. Schick mir die Zeile gern ins GitHub-Ticket.

wert_nicht_erlaubt.message: Die Fritteuse nimmt diese Werte für das Programm „{programm}“ nicht an: {temp} °C, {minuten} Min. Ändere Temperatur oder Zeit (Heißluft braucht z. B. mindestens 120 °C) und versuche es nochmal.

ergebnis_unbekannt.message: No clear answer from the cloud ({fehler}). The command may or may not have reached the air fryer – check the device before you try again.

senden_testen.name: Senden testen (für Bastler)
senden_testen.description: Nur für Admins: schickt Programm, Temperatur und Zeit an eine Zone, ohne zu starten, und zeigt, welche Schreibweise die Fritteuse angenommen hat.

variante.name: Schreibweise
variante.description: Leer = die sicheren Schreibweisen der Reihe nach probieren, bis eine klappt (multi_app, multi_app_celsius, multi_app_zone0). „multi_app_startet“ STARTET die TwinFry sofort wirklich – nur wenn du das willst.

alle.name: Alle probieren
alle.description: An = nicht beim ersten Treffer aufhören.

befehl_senden.name: Send command (for tinkerers)
befehl_senden.description: Admins only: sends any app command to the air fryer and shows the response (without account data).

match_senden.name: Send Match
match_senden.description: Sends the values of zone 1 to both zones (Match). Prepares only – start on the device. Not yet confirmed on the real fryer.

sync_senden.name: Send Sync
sync_senden.description: Sends both zones with their times (Sync) so both finish together. Prepares only – start on the device. Not yet confirmed on the real fryer.

programm_senden.name: Send program
programm_senden.description: For all users: sends program, temperature and time to a zone – prepare only, the fryer never starts by itself (press Start on the device). Without a device the only fryer is used.

geraet.name: Air fryer
geraet.description: Which air fryer? (empty = the only one)

minuten.name: Minutes
minuten.description: Cooking time (limited to the program's range).

variante.name: Variant
variante.description: Optional: send exactly this safe variant (multi_app, multi_app_celsius, multi_app_zone0). Empty = try the safe variants in turn.

einmal.name: Only once
einmal.description: On = send exactly one command: no second variant and no automatic repeat after a new login. If the result is unclear, you decide whether to try again.

streng.name: Strict
streng.description: On = reject values outside the program limits instead of adjusting them silently.

bestaetigen.name: Confirm
bestaetigen.description: On = after sending, check up to 3 times (about 6 s) whether the zone really shows the values. The answer then contains “bestaetigt”.

faehigkeiten.name: Capabilities
faehigkeiten.description: Read only, for all users: programs, temperature and time limits and zones of an air fryer – each marked as confirmed or only estimated. Also connection, last report and revision.

geraet.name: Air fryer
geraet.description: Which air fryer? (empty = the only one)
